#!/bin/sh

set -e
echo "#dpl-update: Preparing project"

set -a

API_URL=$(cat <<'EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
https://api.example.com
EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
)

NODE_ENV=$(cat <<'EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
production
EOF:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
)

set +a

npm ci
npm run build
